info.name: Angkort Shop API - X
info.description:
Postman collection for Angkort e_menu API. Base URL: `/angkort/api/v1`.

**Sections:** Auth, Shop, Product, Order.

Each request includes:
- **Auth:** Public, Bearer, or ownership requirement
- **Path / query / body params** with types and required flag
- Sample payloads where applicable

**Collection variables:** base_url, api_prefix, access_token, shop_id, variant_id, value_id, wifi_id, hour_id, category_id.

request.description:
**Auth:** Public

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| username | string | Yes | User login |
| password | string | Yes | User password |

**Response:** `access_token`, `refresh_token`, expiry info.

**Auth:** Public

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Display name |
| username | string | Yes | Login (must be unique) |
| password | string | Yes | Password |

**Response:** `access_token`, `refresh_token`, user info.

**Auth:** Public

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| refresh_token | string | Yes | Refresh token from login/register |

**Response:** New `access_token` and optionally new `refresh_token`.

**Auth:** Bearer token required

**Request:** No body. Header `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` invalidates the current token.

query.description: Filter shops with WiFi: true | false

request.description:
**Auth:** Public

**Query params:**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| page | int | No | Page number (default 1) |
| limit | int | No | Per page (default 20, max 100) |
| search | string | No | Search name, phone, address |
| sort | string | No | id \| name \| create_date |
| order | string | No | asc \| desc |
| filter_industry | string | No | Industry name filter |
| filter_has_wifi | string | No | true \| false |

**Response:** `data` (shops), `meta.pagination`, `meta.keyword`.

**Auth:** Public

**Path params:**

| Param | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| shop_id | int | Shop (res.partner type=store) ID |

**Response:** Single shop object with banner, wifi, open hours, banks.

**Auth:** Bearer (angkit)

**Body (form-data):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Shop name |
| phone | string | Yes | Phone number |
| customer_address | string | Yes | Shop address |
| wifi_name | string | No | WiFi name(s) |
| email | string | No | Email |
| shop_latitude | number | No | Latitude |
| shop_longitude | number | No | Longitude |
| shop_wifi_ids | string | No | JSON array of {name, password} |
| shop_open_hour_ids | string | No | JSON array of {day, open, close}; day 0=Mon..6=Sun |
| shop_banner | file | No | Banner image |

**Auth:** Bearer (angkit)

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Shop name |
| phone | string | Yes | Phone number |
| customer_address | string | Yes | Shop address |
| wifi_name | string | No | Default "" |
| shop_latitude | number | No | Default 0.0 |
| shop_longitude | number | No | Default 0.0 |
| email | string | No | Default "" |

Body may be wrapped in `params` for JSON-RPC.

formdata.description: JSON array; replaces all WiFi. {name, password} per item.

query.description: Search in product name, code, description

request.description:
**Auth:** Public

**Path:** shop_id (int)

**Query params:** page, limit, search, sort, order, filter_category, filter_price_min, filter_price_max, filter_has_variants.

**Response:** data (products), meta.pagination, meta.keyword.

**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int)

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Product name |
| code | string | No | Internal reference |
| description | string | No | Description |
| sale_price / list_price | number | No | Price |
| category_id / categ_id | int | No | Product category |
| type | string | No | consu \| service |
| image | string | No | Base64 image (JSON) |
| variant_ids | array | No | Attribute IDs (attach all values per attribute) |
| attribute_lines | array | No | [{ attribute_id, value_ids }] for explicit values |

formdata.description: Optional. JSON array of attribute IDs.
Optional. JSON array of { attribute_id, value_ids }.

request.description:
**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int)

**Body (form-data):** Same params as JSON Product Create. Use form when uploading image file. variant_ids and attribute_lines as JSON strings.

**Auth:** Public

**Query params:** page, limit, search, sort, order, filter_shop, filter_category, filter_price_min, filter_price_max, filter_has_variants.

**Auth:** Public

**Path params:** product_id (int) — product.template ID.

**Response:** Single product object with variants, image, category.

**Auth:** Public

**Query params:** page, limit, search, sort, order, filter_parent, filter_has_children.

**Auth:** Public

**Query params:** page, limit, search, sort, order, filter_create_variant (no_variant | always), filter_display_type (multi | radio).

**Auth:** Bearer (angkit)

**Path:** shop_id (int)

**Query params:** search, sort, order, filter_create_variant, filter_display_type.

formdata.description: Required. multi | radio. If multi, create_variant forced to no_variant.

request.description:
**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int)

**Body (form-data):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | Yes | Attribute name (unique per shop) |
| create_variant | string | Yes | no_variant \| always |
| display_type | string | Yes | multi \| radio |

**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int), variant_id (int)

**Body (form-data):** name, create_variant, display_type (same as create). All sent fields updated.

**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int), variant_id (int)

**Body (JSON or form):** Any subset of name (string), create_variant (no_variant | always), display_type (multi | radio). At least one required.

**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path params:** shop_id (int), variant_id (int)

**Response:** 204 No Content.

**Auth:** Bearer (angkit)

**Path:** shop_id (int), variant_id (int)

**Query params:** search, sort, order.

formdata.description: Required. JSON array of { name, extra_price? }.

request.description:
**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int)

**Body (form-data):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| attribute_id | int | Yes | Attribute (variant) ID |
| values | string | Yes | JSON array: [{ name, extra_price? }] |

**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int), value_id (int)

**Body (form-data):** At least one of: name (string), price_extra (number, stored as default_extra_price).

**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path:** shop_id (int), value_id (int)

**Body (form-data):** Same as PUT — any of name, price_extra. At least one required.

**Auth:** Bearer, shop ownership required

**Path params:** shop_id (int), value_id (int)

**Response:** 204 or error.

**Auth:** Bearer

**Body (form-data):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| image | file | Yes | Image file |
| res_id | any | No | Resource ID (default 0) |
| res_model | string | No | Resource model (default ir.ui.view) |

**Response:** image URL, image_id (ir.attachment).

**Auth:** Bearer

**Query params:**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| page | int | No | Page (default 1) |
| limit | int | No | Per page (default 20, max 100) |
| search | string | No | Search |
| order_by | string | No | id \| name \| date_order |
| order_direction | string | No | asc \| desc |

**Response:** Paginated orders for current user.

**Auth:** Bearer

**Path params:** order_id (int)

**Response:** Single order detail for current user (403 if not owner).

**Auth:** Bearer

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| order_lines | array | Yes | [{ product_id, quantity, price_unit? }] |
| note | string | No | Order note |

- product_id: template ID or variant ID (backend resolves).
- quantity: number > 0.
- price_unit: optional; uses product list_price if omitted.

**Auth:** Bearer

**Request body (JSON):** Odoo type=json (JSON-RPC).

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| cart | array | Yes | [{ product_id, quantity }] |

**Response:** sufficient_stock / insufficient_stock, total_amount.

**Auth:** Depends on route

**Query params:** page, limit, search, sort, order, filter_state (draft|sent|sale|done|cancel), filter_date_from, filter_date_to (YYYY-MM-DD), filter_amount_min, filter_amount_max, filter_customer.

**Auth:** Bearer

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| partner_id | int | Yes | Customer (res.partner) ID |
| order_lines | array | Yes | [{ product_id, quantity, price_unit? }] |

product_id here is **product.product** (variant) ID, not template.

**Auth:** Public (runs as internal user)

**Request body (JSON):**

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| partner_id | int | Yes | Customer (res.partner) ID |
| lines | array | Yes | Order line items (see below) |
| shop_id | int | No | Shop (store) partner ID |
| telegram_id | int | No | Telegram user ID |
| order_date | string | No | ISO datetime (e.g. 2025-12-28T10:00:00Z) |
| notes | string | No | Order note |

**Line item:** template_id or product_id/variant_id (one required), qty/quantity (required), variant_value_ids (optional), price_unit, note, addons (optional).

**Addon:** product_id (variant ID), qty/quantity, price_unit?, note?.
